item.title: Open call: Thought pieces on cultural exchange
item.description: The Goethe-Institut has issued an open call for proposals inviting contributions that critically examine the concept of ‘cultural exchange’, with a particular focus on its use within Africa–Europe cultural cooperation. For several decades, the Goethe-Institut and other national cultural institutes have described their work through the lens of ‘cultural exchange’. item.title: Tanzania: Abigail Chams drops Your Loss single, announces Visa partnership
item.description: Tanzanian artist Abigail Chams has released her first single of the year, ‘Your Loss’, accompanied by an official music video and the announcement of a new partnership with Visa. The release follows a period of increased international attention for the Tanzania-based singer, who recently received a BET nomination and achieved viral success with her previous single, ‘Me Too’. ‘Your Loss’ marks her return with a dance-oriented track that draws on dancehall and Afrobeats influences. item.title: Ghana: MOLIY named Spotify EQUAL Africa artist for January
item.description: Ghanaian-American singer and songwriter MOLIY has been named Spotify’s EQUAL Africa artist of the month for January 2026 and features on the cover of the EQUAL Global playlist. The recognition highlights her growing influence in Africa’s music scene and her expanding international profile. Known for her fusion of Afro-pop, Afro-fusion and dancehall, MOLIY combines emotive songwriting with rhythmic energy, earning a rapidly expanding global audience. item.description: The Zimbabwe Music Rights Association (ZIMURA) has issued a public clarification on the disposal of two residential flats in Avondale amid growing public scrutiny, while a group of its own board members has formally distanced itself from the statement, citing governance and procedural concerns. item.title: Why Joburg’s entertainment hub still gives you the biggest head start
item.description: By Mzi Kaka South Africa’s media and entertainment sector is one of the country’s most exciting growth stories. PwC’s outlook shows that it is outperforming global benchmarks, driven by streaming, on-demand video, a resurgent film sector, and a live industry that has already surpassed its pre-pandemic revenue levels. item.title: Deezer unveils revamped Android TV app with enhanced music features
item.description: Deezer, the global music streaming platform, has launched a redesigned version of its Android TV app, offering an updated interface and expanded music features for users worldwide. The app has experienced steady growth on Android TV, prompting Deezer to reimagine the platform from the ground up. item.title: Open call: Live Music Lab 2026 training programme
item.description: Applications have opened for the 2026 edition of Live Music Lab, a fully funded training programme aimed at young people in Johannesburg seeking entry-level experience in the live music industry. The three-month programme, run by live music platform Bassline, will select 10 participants for an intensive combination of classroom learning and practical industry exposure. item.title: Wizkid and Asake release new collaborative single Jogodo
item.description: Nigerian artists Wizkid and Asake have released a new collaborative single, ‘Jogodo’, marking their latest joint project and the lead release from an upcoming EP titled REAL, Vol. 1. The track, released on 16 January, blends Afrobeats with prominent percussion and brass elements. Sung primarily in Nigerian Pidgin, ‘Jogodo’ centres on the idea of intoxication or being under the influence, a theme reflected in both its lyrics and relaxed, rhythmic production. item.title: Ayra Starr nominated in two categories at 2026 MOBO Awards
item.description: Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has received two nominations at the 2026 MOBO Awards, competing in both the Best African Music Act and Best International Act categories. Starr, who made history last year as the first African woman to win both awards simultaneously, faces a competitive field in this year’s edition.
